{"response":{"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","candidates":[{"finishReason":"STOP","content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"thoughtSignature":"","text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n\n  // Basic checks (options and root level)\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n\n  // Step 1: Maintain persistent EMAs of LBD.\n  // We rely on the solver's internal Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs) for 'fast_glue' and 'slow_glue'.\n  // These correspond to the short-term trend and long-term baseline respectively.\n  // Note: We access these read-only as the solver updates them during conflict analysis.\n  const double fast_ema = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow_ema = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n\n  // Step 2: Calculate the momentum ratio R.\n  // R = fast_ema / slow_ema.\n  double R = 1.0;\n  if (slow_ema \u003e 1e-9) // Prevent division by zero\n    R = fast_ema / slow_ema;\n\n  // Step 3: Enforce a minimum run length.\n  // We use a static variable to track the conflict count at the last restart\n  // to ensure we don't restart too frequently (minimum 50 conflicts).\n  static uint64_t last_restart_conflicts = 0;\n\n  // Reset tracking if solver appears to have been reset or is a new instance\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c last_restart_conflicts)\n    last_restart_conflicts = 0;\n\n  uint64_t run_len = CONFLICTS - last_restart_conflicts;\n  if (run_len \u003c 50)\n    return false;\n\n  bool decision = false;\n\n  // Step 4: Focused Mode Strategy\n  if (!solver-\u003estable)\n    {\n      // Trigger a restart if R \u003e 1.15 (quality degrading relative to baseline)\n      if (R \u003e 1.15)\n        decision = true;\n      // Inhibit restarting if R \u003c 0.85 (hot streak)\n      else if (R \u003c 0.85)\n        decision = false;\n      // If 0.85 \u003c= R \u003c= 1.15, we default to not restarting in this strategy\n      else\n        decision = false;\n    }\n  // Step 5: Stable Mode Strategy\n  else\n    {\n      // Check the standard reluctant doubling conflict limit\n      if (kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant))\n        {\n          // Trigger restart ONLY if R \u003e= 0.75\n          if (R \u003e= 0.75)\n            decision = true;\n          // If R \u003c 0.75 (significantly better), inhibit restart to extend stable run\n          else\n            decision = false;\n        }\n      else\n        {\n          decision = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n  // If we decided to restart, update the last restart conflict counter\n  if (decision)\n    {\n      kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                                \"MACD restart triggered: R=%.2f (fast=%.2f, slow=%.2f) \"\n                                \"mode=%s run=%\" PRIu64,\n                                R, fast_ema, slow_ema,\n                                solver-\u003estable ? \"stable\" : \"focused\", run_len);\n      last_restart_conflicts = CONFLICTS;\n    }\n\n  return decision;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e"}]},"index":0}],"responseId":"3tWKacDJOqmCz7IP0Z-zyAk","usageMetadata":{"thoughtsTokenCount":11744,"totalTokenCount":18476,"candidatesTokenCount":796,"promptTokenCount":5936,"promptTokensDetails":[{"modality":"TEXT","tokenCount":5936}]}},"key":"req-0001","model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview"}
